quarterly_data.quarter: Quantum-Si press release: Quantum-Si Demonstrates Detection of 19 Amino Acids in (10-08-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Quantum-Si demonstrated detection of 19 amino acids in its Proteus development program (up from the developmental kit detecting 18 amino acids used for the World HUPO interim results) and is working to deploy the capability into a developmental sequencing kit for routine use on integrated Proteus instruments by its R&D team. CEO Jeff Hawkins: growing increasingly confident in demonstrating detection of all 20 amino acids by year-end 2026; once deployed, the 19-amino-acid capability is expected to further increase Proteus sequencing performance, strengthening confidence in the platform's advancement toward commercial launch in the second quarter of 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: 19 amino acids; all 20 targeted by year-end 2026
